verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm SREs can define SLIs and SLOs, with service-level creation modes ranging from one-click to fully customizable. Separate docs show threshold- and anomaly-based alerting with notification routing, but nothing ties those alerts to SLOs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of error-budget tracking, burn-rate alert conditions on SLOs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
